items.title: Al Gafa interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 2, 2023
items.q: every time I went on a new job with Carmen she would get into an argument... And so when I left Carmen I got the call for Dizzy.

ctx.x: How was he different from, as a leader, from let’s say Carmen McRae?

Oh I knew you were going to bring this up, because this is a really — we’re talking about the sound checks in the afternoon of a new job. Any time — not any time, every time I went on a new job with Carmen she would get into an argument with the club owner or the manager on the afternoon during the sound check, about something. Maybe the lights in the dressing room were not bright, maybe the dressing room needed to be dusted or the rug needed to be vacuumed or this or this. We would start every job with tension.…
That’s a terrific compliment. “If I played the guitar I’d play like you.”
